text:
rachel: Quick ask for upcoming benchmark webinar and post-play: need a minimal asset bundle for launch — 2 hero socials, 4 micro sales tiles, a one-page sales cheat sheet, and a simplified inbound-routing diagram for SDRs.
liam: happy to take. do we prefer gradients or UI shots for hero?
greg: gradients for social, one hero variant should include a cropped UI screenshot for credibility.
sara: i'll supply 3 headline tones (technical / product / biz) and short body copy. will drop into the figma file by EOD Mon.
liam: sizes — hero 1200x628, micro 1200x1200, routing 1600x900, cheat sheet US letter PDF. confirm?
rachel: confirm those sizes. include export formats: SVG + optimized PNG + PDF for cheat sheet. include alt text and short usage notes.
assets-bot: Starter frame created: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/benchkit-ops (marketing-edit). Auto-checklist:
```
hero-social,1200x628,EN/FR,2026-04-04
micro-tile,1200x1200,EN,2026-04-04
routing-diagram,1600x900,EN only + 1920x1080,2026-04-02
sales-cheatsheet,US Letter,EN/FR,2026-04-05
```
liam: i'll do three layout comps (A/B/C) per hero and two per micro tile. will annotate character limits. ETA first draft 2026-04-02 afternoon.
greg: please add a plain-text routing flow for sequences and a 60s loom for SDR handoff.
sara: CTAs to test: "Cut inference cost", "Ship LLM features faster", "Predictable inference economics" 447. i'll flag which for which persona.
rachel: great — priority high for webinar week. liam, once frames are "ready for export" please upload final zip to /marketing/assets/benchkit-2026 and ping legal for quick brand pass on 2026-04-05.
assets-bot: Noted. I'll auto-export final files when frames are marked ready.
